cohort: Six pregnant women who underwent low-frequency jet ventilation during pregnancy for surgical treatment of airway stenosis.
finding: Low-frequency jet ventilation and surgical management of airway stenosis appear to be safe treatment options in pregnant patients, with no immediate complications related to anesthesia or surgery in most cases.
mod_finding: Five mothers delivered via cesarean section and one via spontaneous vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Three infants were delivered at low birth weight.
